author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: JR Howard experienced hardships early on with only a small number of sheep, making it tough to earn a living. However, after landing a grazing contract with solar farms, he expanded his flock and income significantly. This eco-friendly grazing method is being embraced by renewable energy companies as a cost-effective way to manage vegetation, while farmers benefit from expansive grazing land without hefty property expenses.
title: Texas farmer went from 27 sheep to overseeing 10,000 across 40,000 acres

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: Eric Schmidt highlighted that China is approximately six months behind the US in artificial intelligence capabilities. He noted that Chinese companies offering low-cost or free AI products are gaining traction globally. Schmidt expressed concern that this strategy could facilitate significant market advantages for Chinese firms. Additionally, he discussed how smuggled technology has aided China's rapid advancements.
title: Eric Schmidt sees China behind the US in the AI race by at least 6 months

author: TNN
description: “Dimagi naxals have captured Congress so much that it has lost its ability to think. Those who used to cause destruction in forests are now determined to wreak havoc on the country through Congress,” PM Modi said, referring to hardcore Left elements accused of being sympathetic to Maoists and now vocal in protests against EC and govt.
title: Congress defaming India to shield Nehru-Gandhi family: PM Modi

author: NITESH DUBEY
description: Anahat Singh pulled off an impressive comeback against Salma Hany, clinching her spot in the semi-finals at a PSA Gold-level event after a nail-biting five-game match that lasted 42 minutes. The 18-year-old, facing a 1-2 deficit, demonstrated resilience and skill. Anahat will now go head-to-head with Malaysia's Sivasangari Subramaniam, reigniting their rivalry from the Asian Games final, solidifying her remarkable tournament journey in Redwood City.
title: Anahat scripts history, storms into maiden PSA Gold semi-final

author: SAIKAT RAY, KRISHNENDU BANDYOPADHYAY, KAUSHIK PRADHAN
description: Chief Minister Suvendu Adhikari announced that only those who believe in Sanatan Dharma can touch Durga idols during immersion. This directive aims to maintain the sanctity of traditional rituals amidst rising political tensions. Several opposition leaders criticized the decision, alleging it promotes religious exclusion and violates constitutional principles. The immersion involved the use of trolleys instead of cranes, which is a departure from previous practices.
title: Only ‘sanatanis’ will touch Durga idols during immersion: Bengal CM Suvendu

author: TNN
description: On Wednesday night, Sashastra Seema Bal apprehended a group of four individuals near the India-Nepal border in Bahraich district. Among them were three Sri Lankan nationals and a woman from Tamil Nadu attempting to cross into Nepal through a forest route. Security personnel discovered that the passports of the Sri Lankans had expired three months earlier. Authorities are currently investigating their travel circumstances and intended destination.
title: 3 Sri Lankans, Tamil Nadu woman detained near Indo-Nepal border

title: 'Keep it up': Trump backs Ramaswamy's attack ad against Ohio rival

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg reportedly considered selling his $110 million Palo Alto home and leaving California over a proposed 5% wealth tax on billionaires. He has struck an eight-year deal with Meta to remain in California or where the company is headquartered. The agreement provides non-voting shares to help cover a potential multibillion-dollar tax bill while protecting his voting control.
title: Zuckerberg weighed selling $110M home over billionaire tax, struck Meta deal
